Eltima installers bundled Proton RAT.

Target: Eltima Elmedia Player/Folx
Repository: N/A
Date: 2017-10-19 to 2017-10-20 (1 day)
Attribution: Cybercriminal Gang
Component: Application
Language: Swift
Cause: Server compromise
Motive: Financial gain, Data theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Backdoor, Remote access, Credential theft
User Impact:
Domain: mac.eltima.com (project download host)
Artifact Type: binary archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

Eltima Software download servers were compromised, and macOS installers for Elmedia Player and Folx were bundled with the Proton RAT. Users seeking media and download utilities from the official site received remote-access malware folded into otherwise familiar application packages for macOS.
